name: Ineffa
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on the Lunar build: ATK% sands and goblet, CRIT circlet, Fractured Halo first, Aubade of Morningstar and Moon and Silken Moon's Serenade as the best sets. KQM adds EM or ER on the sands/goblet (ER only when her Burst is used every rotation) and a shield-support build (Tenacity, Noblesse Oblige, Deepwood, Scroll), which the card leaves out. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000, CRIT Rate 60-70 (65), CRIT DMG 150, EM 300+, ER 110-140 with a second Electro character (125 used; KQM's baseline for double Electro is 100% with Favonius procs, 140-160 for a Burst every rotation). Her kit's damage is a mix of Skill (Birgitta Discharge) and Burst, with the order Skill > Burst > Normal Attack in Game8 and KQM's 'level > Skill > Burst'. Partners are the Lunar-Charged pair, Electro with Hydro.
